Maria: quick heads-up — I'm opening a PR to update SDK snippets (py/ts/go) for streaming + pagination + retries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1732
Sam: which files are we changing? brief list pls
Maria: iterator streaming examples, cursor pagination samples, and retry/backoff examples. Also normalize cursor metadata to include cursor_expires_at (ms). I'll paste the proposed py snippet.
Maria:
```python
# old streaming example
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
for chunk in c.stream("gpt-xl", prompt):
    process(chunk)
```

```python
# new pattern using RetryPolicy
import time
from redwood import Client, RetryPolicy
c = Client()
retry = RetryPolicy(backoff="exp", max_attempts=3)
for item in c.stream("gpt-xl", prompt, retries=retry):
    handle(item)
```
Alex: TS snippet I'll keep concise:
```ts
const c = new Redwood.Client();
for await (const chunk of c.stream("gpt-xl", { prompt })) {
  handleChunk(chunk);
}
```
Alex: add note about AbortSignal and fetch-style cancellation.
Sam: are we renaming cursor fields? people rely on `cursor` key.
Maria: keeping `cursor`, adding `cursor_expires_at` (ms since epoch). docs note and migration tip required.
Jenny-docs: tagging — I'll add migration blurb and update the CHANGELOG + release notes. Also will grep the repo for cursor edge-cases after the PR lands.
Maria: can someone run playground checks on the TS and Go snippets? I want to avoid broken examples.
Sam: I can run TS playground tonight.
Alex: I'll run Go snippets tomorrow AM; I'll also test retry behavior with a local mock.
